posts.text:
Yesterday (Thu Oct 29), Toronto streetcars spent 189 hours held up beyond a clean run.

Worst: 501 Queen westbound, a typical trip lost 30 min.
Smoothest: 512 St Clair eastbound, 9 min lost.

https://freems88.github.io/ttc-streetcar-delays/

Slowest segment yesterday: Dundas St West eastbound approaching Yonge St - Dundas Station.
Each streetcar lost 104 s here on average, over 112 passes: 3.2 hours in all.
The signal here has no transit priority.
posts.alt: 3D map of Dundas St West around Yonge St - Dundas Station, rotated to Toronto's street grid. Delay is drawn as a coloured ridge above the track, rising where streetcars lose time; the eastbound segment at Yonge St - Dundas Station is highlighted, peaking at about 104 seconds lost per streetcar.
